picks.title: Suno Studio 2.0 puts an AI assistant in the DAW
picks.excerpt: Suno's Studio 2.0 adds a chat-style AI assistant you can direct 'like any other member of the band', alongside MIDI editing, stem separation and automation curves. It pushes the AI song generator further into real DAW territory.
picks.rationale: The prompt box becomes a workstation — MIDI editing, plugins and a directable assistant land inside Suno, which changes how a producer can actually finish a session tomorrow.

picks.title: Beatport is banning fully AI-generated tracks
picks.excerpt: Beatport will refuse tracks 'wholly or substantially' generated by AI while still allowing AI-assisted production where humans keep creative control. The store cites a survey where 77% of DJs backed human artists.
picks.rationale: The biggest dance-music storefront now draws a line between AI-assisted and AI-made, so where your workflow sits decides whether a release can be sold at all.

picks.title: Spotify Labels AI Artists With 'AI Persona' Tag and Cuts Them From Recommendations
picks.excerpt: The AI Persona label rolls out mid-September and removes flagged profiles from editorial and algorithmic recommendations, though royalties are untouched. Self-declaration plus manual review decides who gets tagged.
picks.rationale: A dated, concrete streaming rulebook for AI-fronted acts — self-declare or get flagged, and the cost is discovery, not royalties.

picks.title: IK Multimedia just totally revamped its Tonex Player and made its tone ecosystem a lot easier to use
picks.excerpt: Tonex 2.0 Player enters public beta with 220 new Premium V2 neural Tone Models and a redesigned capture-to-stage workflow. Neural amp modelling keeps moving from novelty to default guitar rig.
picks.rationale: A free public beta with 220 new neural tone captures and a rebuilt capture-to-stage flow — neural modelling as the everyday guitar rig, usable today.

picks.title: Immanent Audio releases IA De-Esser, a FREE de-essing plugin
picks.excerpt: A free four-slot de-esser for macOS and Windows, whose developer says AI sped up development while insisting on shipping no code they don't understand. A small, concrete look at AI inside plugin building.
picks.rationale: A free plugin you can install tonight, plus a rare honest account of where an AI-assisted developer draws the line on code they can't explain.
